items.title: Hevo Group Expands European Footprint With Müritz Acquisition
items.summary: Spanish poultry producer Hevo Group has acquired German egg producer Müritz, which is based roughly 150 kilometres from Berlin.

items.title: Ab InBev Shareholder E.P.S. To Sell 10m Shares In Company
items.summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev's shareholder E.P.S. is selling about 10 million shares in the Belgian brewer, according JPMorgan Securities.

items.title: Ebro Foods Profits Rise 7.1% In H1 Despite Revenue Headwinds
items.summary: Spanish food company Ebro Foods posted a 7.1% increase in net profit, to €103.9 million, in the first half of its 2025 year.

items.title: Asda Starts Growing Again – What a Relief for the UK Grocery Market
items.summary: After more than two years of declining sales, Asda is finally showing signs of recovery. For many people in the retail industry, this is welcome news. It is encouraging to see one of Britain’s biggest supermarket chains moving in the right direction again. According to the…

items.title: Dutch Online Supermarket Crisp Secures €25m For Expansion
items.summary: Dutch online supermarket app Crisp has raised €25 million in a new investment round, to scale up and grow the company.

items.title: Billa Czech Republic Opens Seven Stores, Upgrades 19 In H1 2026
items.summary: Billa Czech Republic has continued to expand its retail footprint by opening seven stores and overhauling another 19 in H1 2026.

items.title: B&M completes POS rollout across 790+ UK stores to improve operational agility and enhance CX in partnership with PMC
items.summary: Abingdon, UK — Value retailer, B&M, has partnered with commerce technology specialist, PMC, to deploy a modernised Point of Sale (POS) solution spanning hardware and software across its entire estate to modernise store operations, improve agility and enhance customer experience…

items.title: Over Half A Million Clubcard Members Have £100 In Unused Vouchers, Tesco Says
items.summary: Tesco is encouraging Clubcard members to use their unspent vouchers, as more than half a million users have over £100 in unused rewards.
